regions.today: Mist and fog in many parts of Leinster early this morning with frost and some icy patches in inland counties. These will gradually clear. Mainly dry today with some bright or sunny spells for a time. Cloud will increase from the southwest. Highest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees with light southeasterly winds increasing moderate to fresh.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be mainly dry and will become increasingly cloudy. Rain will develop in the south of the province overnight. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 10 degrees elsewhere. Moderate to fresh, gusty easterly winds, strong in the south and southwest.
regions.tomorrow: Sunday will be mostly cloudy and quite windy with outbreaks of rain in the south moving slowly northwards. The north of the province will stay largely dry all day. Highest temperatures of 8 to 10 degrees with fresh, gusty easterly winds, strong near coasts.
